paper_title: On a Temporal Logic of Prefixes and Infixes

context: 5 Conclusions In this paper, we proved that the satisfiability problem for BD over homogeneous compass structures is in EXPSPACE. This result improves the previously-known non-elementary upper bound [10]. The problem of determining the exact complexity of the fragment BE, which is known to be EXPSPACE-hard and subsumes BD, [2], remains open. As already pointed out, as a by-product, we obtained a better complexity bound to the problem of checking the emptiness of the fragment of star-free generalized regular expressions that replaces concatenation by prefix and infix relations. In a similar way, a precise characterization of the complexity of the satisfiability problem for BE would be immediately transferable to the emptiness problem for languages in the fragment of star-free generalized regular expressions that replaces concatenation by prefix and suffix relations.
